name: CodeRepoQA
description: CodeRepoQA is a large-scale benchmark for evaluating repository-level question answering in software engineering. It covers five programming languages and diverse scenarios with multi-turn dialogues, constructed from 30 popular GitHub repositories, enabling comprehensive assessment of LLMs' software engineering QA capabilities.
reputation: A recent repository-level QA benchmark that is gaining attention in software engineering LLM evaluation, but it is not yet a broadly established standard.
notes: Multi-turn QA with average 6.62 dialogue turns per entry; publicly available dataset; evaluates LLMs on software engineering questions.
